Intrinsic value 🤣🤣🤣🤣??? There's IS NO INTRINSIC VALUE! Let me correct myself. The intrinsic value is less than inflation at a little under 1% 🤨🤔. Other than what the next fool will pay for it, as Mark does mention, stocks have 1 main value. The SOLE point of owning stock is to get paid dividend. The ONLY OTHER TRUE VALUE it has is the value of the assets in an auction! The majority of modern tech companies assets are very minimal. Most of what they own, besides some real estate, depreciates very fast. Even their patents and intellectual property are worth very little in a short amount of time without the company operating with most of its current employees in it's current condition. It's really insane that stock holders don't demand super high dividends from them for that very reason. It's basically just gambling for scarcity just like Bitcoin! The mean average dividend for the Russell 5,000 companies is less than 1%. At least utility companies and certain other industries own a lot of hard assets with long term intrinsic value. Oh, and they generally pay higher dividends, too. The whole growth thing is a joke. The main reason that growth of a company is good is so it can pay more to it's shareholders in dividends for the long term. The modern stock market is just a greater fools shell game at this point. It's certainly not stupid to make money in it if you can, I'm not saying that. It's just that I can't help but laugh when I hear supposedly serious people talk about "Intrinsic value" and "things being priced in" when these companies pay next to no, or many times no, dividends! I've been running a small C corporation for the past 10 years. I COMPLETELY UNDERSTAND WHAT, IF ANY, INTRINSIC VALUE A SHARE OF STOCK HAS 😆😁 (that's a long story I might dedicate a channel to soon! )
